description: This header defines data structures and concepts related to data flow analysis and identity tracking of tensors in PyTorch's profiler, including types for tensor identities, storage, and mechanisms to handle the ABA problem in tensor lifetime management.

classes.name: WeakTensor
classes.description: A class that holds a weak reference to a TensorImpl to prevent address reuse issues (ABA problem) during profiling.

methods.name: WeakTensor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a WeakTensor from a given at::Tensor.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the TensorImplAddress associated with the weak tensor, used for identity tracking.
